visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a dramatic scene in a dense, dark forest. A lone male figure stands atop a burning pyre of wood, surrounded by smoke and light. Below him, a large crowd of people is gathered, many with their arms raised or gesturing towards the figure on the pyre. The style is characteristic of 19th-century book illustrations, featuring heavy cross-hatching and high-contrast lighting.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: A burning pyre, dense forest trees, smoke, foliage, ground, clothing of the figures.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: A single male figure standing on the pyre, and a large group of onlookers or participants in the foreground and mid-ground.
